method.profiles: Every named DPS build preset, uncovered talent presets with spec defaults, and distinct spec defaults. Settings and rotations are resolved by the UI domain code.
method.support: The common buffs and debuffs in baseline.json replace profile external support. Preset gear, consumables, race, professions, self abilities, and reaction times remain.
method.seed: Every profile uses the same starting seed. Cross-build uncertainty is reported separately; no paired cross-class significance is assumed.
method.scope: One level 63 mechanical target, 3731 armor, fixed duration, no tank, no incoming boss damage. Player movement required by a preset remains enabled.
method.uncertainty: Pointwise approximate 95% Monte Carlo confidence intervals for each mean. These intervals do not measure model error or correct for multiple comparisons.
